subject: Q2 pipeline sweep — pending price exceptions and commit impact
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Myers <jordan@blueflag.com>, Priya Rao <priya@nutriplus.io>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q2 pipeline sweep — pending price exceptions and commit impact

Hi team,

Doing a quick pipeline hygiene sweep ahead of the Q2 close. A few deals are showing as "commit" in SF but have pending pricing exceptions that materially change the committed amount. I want to make sure Finance has the right number before we finalize the forecast. Below are the items I care about right now (short and actionable):

- BlueFlag (RWF-2026-3287): currently marked Commit $650,000. Customer requested a 15% promotional discount for the first year; Deal Desk approval required because it exceeds AE threshold. I attached the pricing-exception form and the latest SOW.
- NutriPlus (internal alias RWF-2026-3310): showing Commit $420,000 but legal pushed a small redline that reduced TCV by ~10%; customer confirmed orally but not updated in SF.
- Meridian Health (RWF-2026-3302): still Negotiation but the AE marked as Commit; no approved discount on file.

Action items (please reply inline):
1) Laura — can you update stage/status in Salesforce for NutriPlus and Meridian by EOD so forecast reflects real risk? Mark NutriPlus as Commit-Pending if the signed doc isn't in SF.
2) Rishi/Deal Desk — please triage BlueFlag pricing-exception. If approved, confirm the final committed value we should use for forecast. If denied, tell us final number so I can move the opportunity to Best Case.
3) Marissa/Karthik — finance ops: please hold off on locking the Q2 committed total until we have Deal Desk verdicts; I will send a follow-up with the reconciled number.

Thanks — want to avoid surprises in tomorrow's forecast call.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pricing-exception-form-BlueFlag.pdf (form, 2 pages), SOW-BlueFlag-v3-signed.pdf (PDF, 7 pages)

From: Jordan Myers <jordan@blueflag.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@nutriplus.io>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Q2 pipeline sweep — pending price exceptions and commit impact

Thanks Ben — we appreciate the heads up. To confirm our side: BlueFlag is asking for a 15% off the first-year subscription (applies to seats + active users) as part of the volume/launch incentive. We signed the SOW you attached yesterday and Jordan will upload the final signed copy to your Drive folder by EOD. Our internal exec sponsor has approved the commercial, and we need the discount to be applied in the contract.

If Deal Desk needs a business justification: we are running a national pilot across three divisions; the incentive is a one-time onboarding concession tied to volume.

Jordan Myers
Director of Product, BlueFlag Software
jordan@blueflag.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Q2 pipeline sweep — pending price exceptions and commit impact

Ben — thanks for the summary. Quick updates from Sales Ops side: 

- NutriPlus (RWF-2026-3310): I set stage to Commit-Pending and added a sales note referencing the legal redline. TCV in SF is still at $420,000 until the signed amendment lands; I set the probability to 80% per our wiring.
- Meridian Health (RWF-2026-3302): changed from Commit to Negotiation. AE confirmed they accelerated the close prematurely; moved to Best Case.
- BlueFlag: left as Commit for now but flagged "pricing-exception-pending".

I'll also create a quick worksheet with the delta for today's forecast (will share link).

On the Deal Desk side — Rishi, can you confirm the expected turnaround? We need to lock numbers for the mid-day forecast call.

Laura Bennett
Manager, Sales Operations

Thanks Laura — I reviewed the BlueFlag request. We can approve a one-time 10% onboarding concession under standard Deal Desk discretionary authority. The additional 5% (to reach 15%) exceeds the delegated threshold and requires SLT sign-off. I've opened internal ticket DD-2026-1427 to route the exception.

Ask to Ben: please upload the customer business justification (one paragraph is fine) to the Deal Desk ticket and confirm whether the discount should apply to only first-year recurring or also professional services. If it is first-year recurring only, use the approved 10% for forecast purposes until we get SLT sign-off.

Rishi Malhotra

Subject: RE: Q2 pipeline sweep — pending price exceptions and commit impact (final numbers)

Thanks all for the quick turn. Final reconciliation for Finance:

- BlueFlag (RWF-2026-3287): use $585,000 as committed for Q2 (we will recognize a 10% approved concession against first-year recurring; SLT decision pending on remaining 5%).
- NutriPlus (RWF-2026-3310): keep at $420,000 commit-pending — update to Commit only after amendment is in SF.
- Meridian Health (RWF-2026-3302): move to Best Case; remove from committed total.

Net change to Q2 committed total: previously reported $2,100,000; revised committed total to use for the mid-day close = $1,965,000. Breakdown and assumptions are in the shared sheet: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1zXg-example-pipeline-docs

Marissa/Karthik — please take the $1,965,000 figure and hold the committed number in the forecast system. If DD finalizes SLT approval for the extra 5% on BlueFlag before close, I will update immediately.
